landing.tagline: Talk your way through a Chinese city with a companion by your side. Every conversation is practice; every practice grows your DNA.
landing.featWorldDesc: Roam the streets, restaurants and train stations of a living city. Talk to NPCs and survive real situations.
landing.featVoiceDesc: Speak out loud. Your companion reacts to your tones, words and pace — no typing required.
landing.featDnaDesc: Nine live skills build a profile of how you learn, with daily missions that target your weak spots.
landing.featCasesDesc: Solve detective cases in Chinese: listen to witnesses, spot the contradiction, name the culprit.
landing.featDuelsDesc: Challenge another learner 1-vs-1: the same questions, the same time, the result decided by the server.
landing.featCompanionsDesc: From Zen capybaras to wise owls — each one teaches with a different style and voice.
landing.hskDisclaimer: No affiliation with the official HSK exam — ChineseVerse only estimates your preparation readiness.

realLife.title: Real-life Chinese
realLife.subtitle: Real situations as real conversations — pitched at your HSK level, so every answer trains the words and grammar you're learning now.

tierHow.beginner: Short, everyday sentences with HSK 1–2 words. You read every line with pinyin and can peek at the translation.
tierHow.intermediate: Longer exchanges with HSK 3–4 words and patterns. Lines are in characters only, and one line is listening-only.
tierHow.advanced: Natural, complex conversations with HSK 5+ language. You hear each line before you can read it, and choose from four replies.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
vocabulary.facts: {{known}} known · {{mastered}} mastered · {{active}} in review · {{due}} due now
vocabulary.basis: Counted from your graded vocabulary answers in every kind of round, plus your spaced-repetition records.

can.strong: You reliably recognise and recall the words you've studied.
can.developing: You recognise most of the words you've studied; some still slip.
can.emerging: Your words are still forming — review will lock them in.
can.none: Not enough answers yet to say.

characters.title: Characters
characters.basis: Counted from character questions (meaning and tone) and your stroke-order tracing.

can.strong: You read the characters you've practised, tones included.
can.developing: You read most practised characters; tones or meanings sometimes trip you.
can.emerging: Characters are still new to you — keep meeting them.
can.none: Not enough answers yet to say.

reading.title: Reading
reading.basis: Counted from questions where you had to read Chinese: meanings, sentences, replies, case clues and real texts.

can.strong: You can read short real Chinese texts and get the point.
can.developing: You understand most of what you read at your level.
can.emerging: Reading takes effort — adapted texts will help.
can.none: Not enough answers yet to say.

listening.title: Listening
listening.basis: Counted from questions you could only hear: listening drills, scene and sentence audio, Sound World and spoken clues.

can.strong: You can follow everyday spoken Chinese at your level.
can.developing: You catch most of what you hear; fast speech is harder.
can.emerging: Listening is your growing edge — slow it down and replay.
can.none: Not enough answers yet to say.

grammar.title: Grammar
grammar.basis: Counted from grammar-point and word-order questions, plus your grammar records.

can.strong: You recognise and use the patterns you've studied.
can.developing: You recognise most patterns; word order sometimes slips.
can.none: Not enough answers yet to say.

speaking.title: Speaking
speaking.basis: Counted from your spoken turns, scored from what the speech recogniser heard.

can.strong: You can say short sentences clearly enough to be understood.
can.developing: You're understood most of the time; tones need care.
can.emerging: Speaking is just starting — short phrases first.
